why: One registry, read by the extractor AND by the provenance manifest, so the set of inputs cannot drift from the set of rows. Every row names the exact file and field or marker it consumes. A probe that cannot be resolved -- file absent, unreadable, path missing, pattern unmatched -- makes its row NOT_ESTABLISHED; it is never filled from a remembered conclusion. A row whose probes all resolve but matches no rule is also NOT_ESTABLISHED, with the probe values printed, because an unclassifiable combination is a finding rather than a default.

category_vocabulary.ESTABLISHED: positively demonstrated by the named evidence
category_vocabulary.ESTABLISHED_WITH_LIMITS: demonstrated in part; the limit is recorded
category_vocabulary.ESTABLISHED_NEGATIVE: measured, and the property does NOT hold -- a result, not a gap
category_vocabulary.VACUOUS: satisfied only because the set it quantifies over is empty
category_vocabulary.REFUSAL_ENFORCED: the refusal path is demonstrated reachable and load-bearing
category_vocabulary.MEASURED_DETERMINISTIC_PROJECTION_LOW: artifact-derived, and the prior projection understates it
category_vocabulary.MEASURED_CURRENT_RUN_ONLY: timing family; a current-run observation, not reproducible
category_vocabulary.NOT_ESTABLISHED: evidence missing, unreadable, ambiguous or unclassifiable
category_vocabulary.NOT_REPRESENTABLE: the model cannot represent the distinction -- demonstrated, not inferred
category_vocabulary.REPRESENTABLE: the model can represent the distinction
category_vocabulary.NAMED_AND_FAIL_CLOSED: a decidable feature class is named as excluded and its refusal is demonstrated reachable
category_vocabulary.RECONCILED_TO_CARRIED_CONSTRAINT: traced to a constraint an earlier lane already carried forward; not an independent finding
category_vocabulary.NO_FAIL_OPEN_TO_RECONCILE: nothing fails open, so there is nothing to trace

rules.note: The index-derived control must be FALSE: an identity that also survived reordering when derived from position would mean the reorder arm was not discriminating.

rules.note: Zero collisions over a non-empty declaration set, with the same-name-different-owner extension case distinguished by owner.

rules.note: Four signature-moved/body-identical cases plus a reachable type-parameter refusal. A refusal that is representable but never reached would not prove the boundary is enforced.

rules.note: Two unsupported-body refusals, one on each side of the comparison: an unencodable BASELINE is as disqualifying as an unencodable variant, or "equal" means "equal in the parts I looked at".

rules.note: an ABI move refuses reuse, including when only the OWNER moved

rules.note: More than one domain, so the derivation distinguishes rather than assigning everything to one bucket.

rows.question: Is a cross-domain private reference refused, and is the platform domain refused separately?

rules.note: Every category in the policy return surface is EXERCISED, so no refusal is merely declared -- an unexercised category may be unreachable. The platform refusal is shown load-bearing: dropping it from the policy makes PLATFORM_DOMAIN_PRIVATE unreachable, and the weakened policies fail their arms, so the suite is not vacuous.

rules.note: measured and fully enforced
The measurement is verified, but enforcement is PARTIAL: G4 carried that limitation forward rather than closing it.

rows.question: When a retention class is withheld, does load fail closed?

rules.note: every withheld class failed closed
MEASURED AND DOES NOT HOLD. Withholding some classes does not fail closed at load. This is a reproduced negative result, not a gap in the evidence, and it is a direct input to routing.

rows.question: Is the retention fail-open an independent SEMANTIC-MAP-1 finding, or the same defect SEMANTIC-LINKER-1 already diagnosed and carried forward?
rows.why_this_row_exists: FINAL's first routing output recommended a NEW lane for RETENTION_WITHHELD_FAILS_CLOSED. That was wrong, and wrong in a specific way worth naming: it proposed work without checking what had already been measured. SL1-FINAL routed PROCEED -> SEMANTIC-MAP-1 and carried "module-side dynamic-interface validation must become fail-closed" forward as a MANDATORY constraint, with the mechanism already diagnosed. G4 then measured exactly that. This row reconciles the two records so the routing names the existing constraint instead of inventing a lane -- and it reads SL1's evidence rather than trusting the recollection.

rules.note: Not an independent finding. Every retention class that fails open at load has cause DYNAMIC_INTERFACE_POLICY, and the one that fails CLOSED (callable) has a different cause (IMPORT_RESOLUTION) -- so the split follows the mechanism, not the class. SL1-G6A recorded the matching negatives under the same category, SL1-G6C named the root cause as MODULE_SIDE_DYNAMIC_INTERFACE_VALIDATION and left it BLOCKING_FOR_PRODUCTION, and SL1-FINAL carried it into this lane as a mandatory constraint. The mechanism: KernelTarget.validateDynamicModule runs only when the CFE is given dynamicInterfaceSpecificationUri while compiling the MODULE; dart2bytecode has no such option, and gen_kernel consumes --dynamic-interface on the HOST compile, where it annotates rather than validates. Routing must name that constraint, not open a new lane.
no retention class fails open, so there is nothing to trace

rows.question: Is every declaration the map admits as patchable actually demonstrated patchable?

rules.note: a non-empty admitted set, every member demonstrated

The subset property is satisfied because the admitted set is EMPTY. Zero admitted is not positive patchability evidence: no declaration was mechanically established safely patchable. NOT_INLINED and pool-indirect observations remain non-safety facts.

rows.question: Can the map represent "patchable" as a property OF A DECLARATION at all?
rows.why_this_row_exists: The verdict predicate for MODIFY_MAP_DESIGN was previously satisfied by a vacuous subset plus ANY unresolved production blocker, so an unrelated prerequisite -- a provenance requirement on where the inlining note comes from, say -- could manufacture a map-design verdict. #48/#58 require evidence that the MODEL cannot represent the distinction. That evidence exists in the bank and is extracted here as its own row, so the predicate reads representability directly instead of inferring it from a blocker count.

patch_attached.pattern: ATTACH: C\+\+ invoke of target returned: PATCHED-w

rules.note: The patch ATTACHED -- the C++ invoke of the target returned PATCHED-w -- and in the same run the direct call read PATCHED-w while the virtual call still read OLD-w. One declaration is therefore patched and not-observed simultaneously, depending on the call site, so "patchable" is not a property the map can carry per declaration. The dispatch predicate fails closed rather than classifying, which is the model declining to represent a distinction it cannot make.
The experiment ran, no call site diverged from the attached patch, and the dispatch predicate classified rather than failing closed.

rows.question: Does the map name a decidable feature class it EXCLUDES, and is that exclusion proven to fail closed rather than merely declared?
rows.why_this_row_exists: REDUCE_SCOPE means "the model works after excluding a decidable feature class". The classifier previously approximated that with "some required row is non-positive", which is satisfied by a retention limitation or by the vacuous patchability result -- neither of which is an exclusion. The exclusion has to be NAMED and its refusal has to be REACHABLE, so it is extracted here from the boundaries the gates actually enforce. This row is deliberately NOT required for PROCEED: proceeding means no exclusion was needed, so its absence is not a defect.
rows.named_classes: ABI: named, optional-positional and type arguments (ROADMAP P2), refused before publication. BODY: Kernel nodes outside the supported encoding (ForStatement in the corpus). PRIVACY: cross-domain and platform-domain private references.

rules.note: Each excluded class is NAMED in the map contract and its refusal is REACHED, not merely representable: the type-parameter shape is refused, an unsupported body refuses on either side of the comparison, and every privacy refusal category in the return surface is exercised. A refusal that exists in the code but is never reached would leave the exclusion undecidable in practice.
no feature class is excluded, so there is nothing to reduce to

rows.question: Is an over-claimed patchable declaration refused, on fixtures and on real corpora?

rules.note: Three scorer arms (partly stale, wholly stale, no demonstration row) and an injected admitted row refused on each real corpus. These are reproduced FAIL_OPEN findings, never a green result.

rows.question: Can a map be applied only to the release it was generated against?

rules.note: The full AOT SHA-256 is the AUTHORITATIVE release identity. The GNU build ID is recorded as a DIAGNOSTIC only: build ids hash four snapshot segments and collide across different AOTs, so a build-id match is not a release match.

rows.question: Does the map carry a schema version, and is a version swap refused?

rules.note: The map names its schema version, its own digest, and the generator that produced it; every falsifier swap is refused.

rows.question: How large is the map relative to the release AOT?

rules.note: Artifact-derived byte counts, identical across runs. No compact encoding is claimed: the map is JSON here.

rows.question: What does generating the map cost in wall time?

rules.note: TIMING FAMILY, deliberately kept separate from the deterministic figures. These values are current-run observations and are not reproducible across runs. The order-dependence label set moves between identical runs even with the noise gate, so the max(stdev) classifier is a COST DIAGNOSTIC only -- never a safety or causality claim.

rows.question: What does retention cost in AOT bytes at real-app scale, and does G4's projection hold?

rules.note: Artifact-derived and reproducible. G4's retention curve UNDERSTATES the measured cost, so the projection may not be substituted for a measurement at the scale being shipped.
measured cost at or below the projection

rows.question: Does the whole evidence set rebuild from clean state, with its refusals intact?

rules.note: REPRODUCTION: PASS means the evidence AND its refusals reproduce. It is not a statement of production readiness -- PRODUCTION_PREREQUISITES is a separate partition and is carried separately into KNOWN_GAPS and routing.

positive_categories.why: The set of categories that count as POSITIVE evidence lived in TWO places -- the extractor used it to build KNOWN_GAPS, the classifier used it for EVERY_REQUIRED_ROW_POSITIVE -- and they drifted the moment two categories were added: DECIDABLE_EXCLUSIONS = NAMED_AND_FAIL_CLOSED was counted as a positive finding by the classifier and simultaneously listed as a known GAP by the extractor. Same failure as the derived-arm rule in G8. One definition, and it is data.
